name: Angels Landing
why: Up the 21 switchbacks of Walter's Wiggles, then along a narrow fin of sandstone on chains to a summit 450 m above the Virgin River.
book: Permit by lottery for the chains past Scout Lookout (seasonal lottery months ahead, or the day-before lottery that closes at 3 pm MT; $6 to apply). Scout Lookout needs no permit. Park shuttle to stop 6, The Grotto.
water: None on the trail: carry 2-3 litres, more in summer.
dangers: Drops of 300 m on both sides of the chains section: deaths have happened.
Do not go up the chains when the rock is wet, icy or a storm is near.
Summer heat over 38°C on the switchbacks: start early.
turnaround: Turn back at Scout Lookout without a permit, or if the rock is wet.

points.name: The Grotto trailhead

points.name: Refrigerator Canyon

points.name: Scout Lookout

points.name: Angels Landing
